title: Reel 2 begins; back to Banashak
summary: Reel change; interviewer and Matassa sort out that they were on Banashak, not Ruffino.

blocks.x: Right. Well, yeah, okay, on that grounds. Okay, we're on reel 2, Cosmo Matassa, January 15, 1994. I'm going to say 95 or 96. At least I could go up. So...
We were talking about Joe Rufino, I think.

Oh, yeah. Yeah. Well, I'm trying to call it... The main thing, I think, if you're going to capsule it, is that he did do a lot of good records, you know, and that kind of stuff. And I guess he'll be remembered for that, and that's nice.
And I said Rufino, we were on Joe Banaszczak.
Oh, Banaszczak, right. Yeah, yeah, okay. I'm sorry. I'll get back into focus.
